data.one_liner: Retrieve App Set ID on Android, IDfV on iOS, MAC address on macOS, and user agent on Web.
data.what_it_does: A tiny Flutter library to retrieve a vendor-specific privacy-friendly device-unique identifier. It provides the App Set ID on Android, Identifier for Vendor on iOS, a MAC address fallback on macOS, and the browser user agent on Web.
use_when: You need a privacy-friendly device-unique identifier scoped to the vendor or developer account.
You want to retrieve IDfV on iOS or App Set ID on Android easily.
avoid_when: You need a persistent tracking device ID across different developers on Android.
You require a reliable, true unique hardware device identifier on the web platform.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API with a single method call.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Web implementation returns the browser user agent, which is not a proper identifier.
macOS fallback relies on the MAC address instead of a real IDfV.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive device and operating system information across platforms, which may include identifiers if needed.
